name: Okitsune-sama ni Onegai
source:
Main character's elder brother is moving out. The fox at the nearby Inari Shrine promises protagonist to make his dream come true in return for regular cleaning the shrine. He makes a wish to become older and spend one day with his brother.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-may-2004-carnival.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角的哥哥要搬出去了。附近稻荷神社的狐狸承诺主角实现他的梦想，作为定期清洁神社的回报。他许愿有一天能长大并与他的兄弟共度一天。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-may-2004-carnival.html]vndbreview[/url]]
